name: Google login, with ID token
blurb: Your Google login, for tools that refresh it themselves and send your ID token.
guide: Log in on this machine as you normally do: gcloud auth login.

For tools that refresh a Google login themselves rather than take a token, such as a CLI that sends your ID token beside a token. Within mwt exec CREDENTIAL -- COMMAND, GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS names a login file of placeholders; its refresh never leaves MWT, which answers it from the command below.

The command prints your access token and your ID token. The ID token's placeholder shows only its issuer, audience, times, email and domain. Name the header the tool sends the ID token in when it isn't Authorization.
If the service takes an ID token only while it is young, keep each value at most a few minutes: 4 for one that refuses tokens issued more than 5 minutes before.

fields.purpose: Google: tools that refresh my login themselves, with my ID token.
